dataset.description:
The goal of this interview is to identify the production potential and market prospects for lecithin derived from rapeseed oil waste in the food industry. The research is led by researchers with sufficient experience and appropriate qualifications.
Experts will be recruited, selected and interviewed in the research, and the results will be analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively. Participants will be selected using targeted selection and contacts among experts/entrepreneurs in the food production industry. Each potential participant will receive a personalized invitation to participate in the study, which will outline the purpose of the study and the importance of participation. Invitations will be sent electronically, and anonymity and confidentiality will be guaranteed to participants. Data collection and processing will be anonymous.

distribution.title:
The goal of the grant is to develop an innovative technology for processing a by-product of rapeseed oil production—soapstock—into a high-value food emulsifier, lecithin. This technology will promote waste reduction, efficient resource utilization, and the development of a circular economy, ensuring sustainable solutions. The main tasks of the grant include developing laboratory methods for lecithin extraction, isolating phosphatidylcholine—a valuable component of lecithin—and conducting market research to evaluate product development opportunities. The grant also aims to prepare and publish scientific articles in internationally recognized journals and to develop and submit a proposal for an international research project.

dmp.description:
The purpose of the Data Management Plan (DMP) is to contribute to the efficient collection, storage, analysis and sharing of data at all the stages of research grant project implementation while ensuring compliance with the legal and ethical requirements. It is a document that forms the basis for organising and managing data to successfully achieve the goal of the research grant project and its activities.
Its goal is to develop an innovative technology for processing a by-product of rapeseed oil production – soapstock – to produce high-value food emulsifier lecithin. The technology can contribute to waste reduction, resource efficiency and the circular economy by providing sustainable solutions. The main objectives of the research grant project involve the development of laboratory methods for lecithin extraction, the isolation of phosphatidylcholine – a valuable component of lecithin – and market research to assess opportunities for the product. It is planned to publish scientific articles in internationally recognized journals, and to prepare and submit an international research project proposal.
The DMP is going to ensure the quality, availability and sustainability of the data while contributing to achieving the goal of the project and increasing the impacts of the project results in both the scientific and practical fields.
